description: This file defines a PHP trait named ControllerTrait within the OrangeHRM project. It provides utility methods for forwarding requests, retrieving the current request, and performing redirects, facilitating controller operations in the framework.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Forwards the current request to another controller by creating a sub-request with specified attributes and query parameters, then handling it through the framework kernel.

methods.name: getCurrentRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the current HTTP request object from the request stack.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Generates a redirect response to the specified path, constructing the full URL based on the current request's scheme and host.
